items.text: 融合创作节点：同节点展示结果、历史和参数，共用副本同步，独立修改后分支。
items.text_en: Unified creation nodes show results, history and parameters; shared copies follow updates until branched.

items.text: 外部 Agent 可组织剧本、分段、资产与视频，创作进度按虚线关系同步。
items.text_en: External agents organize scripts, segments, assets and video; production progress follows dashed relations.

items.text: 统一参数点选、节点工具栏和创作进度固定控制，保留各模型真实参数差异。
items.text_en: Consistent parameter choices, node toolbars and production pin controls preserve model-specific values.

items.text: 音视频共用可拖动时间轴，支持裁剪、首帧/当前帧/尾帧和音频提取，结果用虚线关联。
items.text_en: Shared draggable audio/video timelines support trimming, frame and audio extraction with linked derived results.

items.text: 修复媒体工具存在但无法启动的检测，运行状态动效不再随画布操作重启。
items.text_en: Validate media tool startup and preserve running animations across canvas interactions.

items.text: 安全升级：独立依赖环境、启动验证、程序与结构化数据备份、失败恢复。
items.text_en: Safe updates prepare an isolated dependency environment, verify startup, back up program/data and recover failures.

items.text: 旧版 2026.09.10 首次升级需使用仓库根目录 canvas_update.py，详见 README；升级前保存画布并结束任务。
items.text_en: For the first upgrade from 2026.09.10, use canvas_update.py from the repository root; see README. Save your canvas and finish tasks first.
